author: Reuters
description:
Before the World Cup even began, another competition was already underway: filling up the 2026 official sticker album. The decades-old tradition has collectors and soccer fans opening sticker packs, trading and hunting for missing players. 
 
Collectibles brand Topps is set to produce exclusive FIFA-themed stickers and trading ‌cards from 2031, after its parent company Fanatics signed a long-term licensing deal with the global soccer body, ending FIFA's six-decade partnership with Panini.
 
Producer Ethan Plotkin went to Bleecker Trading in New York City to learn about the craze.
